dialogs.about: 손주가 집에서 피아노로 새 곡을 들려줌

lines.en: Grandma, listen to my new song!
lines.ko: 할머니, 제 새 노래 좀 들어 봐요.

lines.en: That melody is beautiful. Did you practice today?
Yes. I practiced the piano this morning.
Wonderful! I will clap for you.
My friend plays the guitar and the drum.
Can you play that tune slowly again?
lines.ko: 그 곡조를 천천히 다시 쳐 줄래요?

lines.en: Sure. Please hum with me, Grandma.
Okay. Your grandpa played the flute long ago.
Really? Will he play the flute again?
Maybe. Let's ask him at dinner tonight.

dialogs.about: 마을 노래 교실에서 선생님과 연습을 시작함

lines.en: Good afternoon. Are you ready to sing?
Good afternoon. Yes, I am ready today.
Good. I will play the piano for you.
That tune is hard. Can we start slowly?
Of course. First, hum the melody together.
I practiced this song at home yesterday.
Very good. Now everyone, please clap together.
lines.ko: 아주 좋아요. 이제 다 같이 손뼉을 쳐요.

lines.en: Will we sing with a drum next week?
Yes. And my son will bring his guitar.
lines.ko: 네. 제 아들이 기타도 가져올 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you. I enjoy this class very much.
